title: Crystalized Blue Sour Raspberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Crystalized’s Blue Sour Raspberry delivers a bold burst of tangy Blue Raspberry with an extra sour edge for a vibrant and mouth-watering vape. The juicy sweetness of ripe Blue Raspberry is perfectly counterbalanced by a sharp, sour twist, creating an electrifying balance of sweet and tart. This lively blend keeps the tastebuds engaged from inhale to exhale, offering an endlessly satisfying vaping experience. With a versatile 50% VG / 50% PG, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced formula ensures a consistent flavour and a smooth yet tactile throat hit with discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Crystalized is a UK-based e-liquid brand dedicated to crafting distinctive, flavourful vape juices with an emphasis on MTL vaping. Their 50/50 VG/PG shortfills deliver clean, bright, and consistent flavours, making them an excellent choice for everyday vaping.
